SELECT 'config' AS kind, json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'pending', json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox_pending',json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'bookings' AS kind, json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config', json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights

SELECT 'pending' AS kind, json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status)) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered'
